sn52.5:1.2: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā sārīputto āyasmantaṃ anuruddhaṃ etadavoca
sn52.5:1.3: asekkhenāvuso anuruddha bhikkhunā katame dhammā upasampajja vihātabbāti.
sn52.5:1.4: asekkhenāvuso sārīputta bhikkhunā cattāro satipaṭṭhānā upasampajja vihātabbā.
sn52.5:1.6: idhāvuso bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
sn52.5:1.9: dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
sn52.5:1.10: asekkhenāvuso sārīputta bhikkhunā ime cattāro satipaṭṭhānā upasampajja vihātabbāti.
